title: OBJ Trim
content: **List of Contents** **Open/Add** **Arrangement** **Glue** **Set Properties** **Set Options** **Simulation** #### **Manage Trim as a style in the Object Browser.** **** #### #### **Open/Add** 1. Click the ![add text.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38277322074905) button in the Trim tab in the Object Browser. 2. Import an [OBJ file](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000494107-3D-File-OBJ-Import-Export#h_01J8YNPZ4XZ0BYCVRQ5PXVP1SF) as a Trim, or open the Trim (TRM) file. 3. Drag and Drop the Trim Style to the 3D window from the Object Browser. #### #### **Arrangement** You can easily place trims on the garment without gluing. 1\. Using ![Select On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38277322076313) **Select/Move** tool in the 3D toolbar , click ![Direct Positiong.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44950723624601)**Direct Positioning** next to the Gizmo. 2\. Hover over the pattern and click the desired location. #### **Selection** **Selecting trims only:** * **Single, specific trims:** Click on the trim in the 3D window with the ![Select On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38277322076313)**Select/Move** tool. Hold **Shift** to add to the selection as you click. * **Trims of the same type loaded into the scene more than once:** Select the trim group in the **Object Browser** , all instances of it will highlight in the 3D window. To select several different trim groups, hold either **Shift** or **Ctrl (Windows) / Cmmd (Mac)** to make the desired selection as you click. * **All trims present in the scene:** Right-click on any trim in the 3D window and choose **Select All Trims** from the right-click menu. **Selecting trims in combination with patterns:** 1. Select all trims needed in the **Object Browser** , all instances of them will highlight in the 3D window. 2. Hold **Shift** and add the desired patterns to the selection via the **Transform Pattern** tool in the 2D window. #### **Glue** **Single Point** 1. Click on the Trim in 3D window with ![Select On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38277322076313)**Select/Move** tool. 2. Click the Glue button next to the Gizmo, then click on the desired location. 3. Click the ![Simulation Normal On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38277322078617)**Simulate** tool. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38279125681945)** **Multiple Points**[**![Youtube Icon \(1\).png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/53053444108825)**](https://youtu.be/iflI4v36pi4?si=UdIX4L8cmCmOnmEs&t=494) **** Attach trims to desired locations by tacking them to multiple points across various patterns. 1\. Using **![Tack On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/44950723625753)Tack** tool in the 3D toolbar, click on an initial point on thr trim. 2\. Click on the desired point on the garment. _* Repeat the step to tack the trim to multiple points._ __ 3\. Click the ![Simulation Normal On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38277322078617)**Simulate** tool. **📝 Note:** Tack is not available on deactivated trims. #### #### **Set Properties** 1. Set the trim style properties or options by clicking the trim style in the Object Browser. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Information** | Enter the information of trim **Specification** | **Scale** | Scale trim with X, Y, and Z-axis. **📝 Note:** You can directly scale the trim using the gizmo by clicking the ![scale_gizmo.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38277540580761)******scale** button next to the gizmo in 3D window. **Axis** | Enter the desired value for each axis. **Lock** **Aspect Ratio** | Toggle this option on to adjust a trim while maintaining its x, y, and z ratio. **Weight** | Set the weight of trim. The entered value of weight is reflected in the simulation. **Material** | Set the [Material](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360047317454-Set-Fabric-Materials). 2. Or set the trim properties individually by clicking on the trim in 3D window. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Name** | If each part(meshes) of the OBJ trim is composed of two or more parts, you can set the name for each part individually. **Collision** | Set whether you turn the Collision on or off. It only enables or disables the Collision of detached trim. **Collision Thickness** | Set the Collision Thickness with a garment. The higher the value is, the farther the distance with a garment is in the simulation. **Material** | Partially set the material of trim #### #### **Set Options** 1. Right- click on the trim in the 3D window to set the options. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Select All Trims** | Select all trims in the 3D Window. **Delete** | Delete selected trims. **Copy/ Paste** | Copy and paste the selected trims. **Duplicate to Symmerty Pattern** | Duplicate the selected trims to the symmetry pattern. **Unglue** | The attatched trim is being detached from the Pattern. **Hide Trim/Show All Trims** | Hide or Show all trims. **Show/Hide All Trim Stuatus Color** | Hide or Show the color as per its simulation status. ![Trim Simulation Status Color ON-OFF.gif](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/48716887231513) ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38279125681945) #### **Simulation** Simulate trim to achieve realistic movement and seamless, stable interaction with 3D garments. **📝 Note:** Trim simulation is available only for unglued trims, which are set to Activate by default with both simulation and collision applied. 1. Arrange the trim in the desired position on the 3D garment in the 3D window, then click the ![Simulation Normal On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38277322078617)**Simulate** tool. 2. If you want to activate only collision without simulation, right-click on the trim and click the**Freeze** menu. 3. Or, if you want to deactivate both collision and simulation, and click the **Deactivate** menu. ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38279125681945)
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for managing trims in 3D garment design, detailing processes for adding, arranging, gluing, and simulating trims effectively.

title: Pattern Drafter
content: **List of Contents** Open Create Pattern Edit Pattern Add Grading AI Pattern Drafter (Beta) **** Easily Create your First Pattern within CLO, using either measurement points or your flat sketches. ![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45053653355417) [Watch Video](https://youtu.be/X0GSGKGGYaM) #### **Open** 1. Click the 2D ▶ **Pattern Drafter** in the top menu. 2. Choose a Pattern Type to start drafting your patterns. **** #### **Create Pattern** 1. Set Measurement provide 3 different options to view and adjust pattern measurements. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **General** | This will give you a complete list of the most commonly used Points of Measure for that style. **Simple** | This will give you the most commonly used points of measure for simple editing of patterns. **Custom** | This is automatically adjust to Custom when you select your own measurement list and customize to your preference. 1\. Click ![setting.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45585774347289) **Setting** button to view the full list of measurements. 2\. Use the checkbox to show or hide items as needed. 3\. Once setup is complete, click ![Total-1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45585774352537) **Exit** button to apply changes. 2. Enter your pattern measurement values. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **![Total.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45585774384537)Total** | Certain Measurements include the Toptal option to input the full front and back circumference. **Base** | Certain measurements include dropdown options, as they are commonly taken from different areas of the pattern. E.g. **\- Total Length:** High Point Shoulder, Or Center Front/ Back **\- Across Front/ Back:** 4", 5" or 6" from High Point Shoulder **\- Across Waist:** 4", 5" or 6" from Armhole **\- Across Bust/ Chest:** Armhole to Armhole or 1" from Armhole **\- Bicep Width:** Armhole to Armhole or 1" from Armhole **Symmetry** | Set the front and back pattern to Symmetry or Half Symmetry ![list.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45586096388121) **Show All Measurement** | View all inactive measurements in each section. 3. Click the ![Create.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55646905944985) button. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55681539045401)** ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55673983170329) When a Parametric Pattern is created to automatically create the[ POM](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/sections/360004712034-POM) from the parametric Patterns. * Only the defined measurements are generated as 2D POMs and added to the [POM Obejct Browser](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/37542686165529-POM-Object-Browser). * Automatically generated POMs can only be selected with the [Edit POM ](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360025716814-Edit-2D-POM)tool to check their length. ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55673983170329) #### **Edit Pattern** Patterns created with Pattern Drafter can be edited while retaining their original parameters. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55681539045401)** **in Pattern Drafter** 1. Open the Pattern Drafter. → If a parametric pattern exists, select whether to create a new pattern or edit it. 2. Select the ![Frame 215.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55673983171865) button. → The pattern type is automatically detected. 3. Change the measurement values, then click the ![Update.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55673922190361)**** button. Or, click ![Create as New.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55673983175705) button to generate a new parametric pattern. **![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55681539045401)** **with Edit POM tool** 1. Click the ![Edit Point of Measure On.jpg](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55681585911065) [**Edit POM**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/360025716814-Edit-2D-POM)**** tool in the 2D toolbar. 2. Click a POM within the parametric pattern and enter a value in the length field. → The parametric pattern updates based on the entered value while maintaining its parametric relationships, the same as editing in Pattern Drafter. **📝****Note** : Editing a parametric pattern directly breaks its connection with Pattern Drafter. It is recommended to edit the pattern using Pattern Drafter or the Edit POM tool instead. ![Label.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55673983170329) #### **Add Grading** 1. Click the ![Add Grading.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55684986671129) **Add Grading** in the Pattern Drafter. 2. Set up the size table for graded patterns, then click the**OK.** **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Add** | Add new sizes by clicking ![add.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55685003829017) **Add** button. When a size is selected, clicking**Add** inserts a new size above the selected size. **Rename** | Rename a size by double-clicking a size name. **Delete** | Delete a size by clicking a size and pressing the **Delete** key. → Size columns are added to the Measurement table. 3. Enter full measurement values for each size or specify grading increments between sizes. 4. Click the ![Create.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55646905944985) button. → The pattern is graded based on the entered value. _**✨Tip:** _Grading can be adjusted directly with the ![Edit Grading Curve On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55684986679961)****[**Edit Grading**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115015798567-Set-Grading#h_01JR7KQV8PQACMKZBJA4J97SNT)**** tool. #### **AI Pattern Drafter (Beta)** Using a Sketch CLO will Automatically generate measurements to create a drafted pattern for you. 1. Click **AI Pattern Drafter (Beta)** button on the top right of the Pattern Drafter. 2. Generate a background image to be composited by entering prompts or upload it directly. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Text Prompt** | Select the garment type and write in your sketch idea. Make sure to add in as many descriptive words as possible. if you want to emphasize something place it in brackets. **✨ Writing Tips:** Listing the desired words rather than long descriptive sentences can generate more effective results. ![Comment.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45587052844441)**Keyword Suggestions** | Suggested keywords will appear as you type to help you complete your prompt. ![icon_pin_off.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45587052847001)**Maintain Prompt** | Even if the same prompts are used, the AI Pattern image is created anew each time. Thus, clicking the Maintain Prompt button may update the prompts while preserving the existing results as much as possible. The results may differ from the existing ones depending on the addition or change of the prompts. ![icon_random_dice.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45587052849049) **Random** | Sample prompts are provided randomly ![Editor Edit.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45587052849945) **Clear** | Clear anything that was written to restart. **Image** | Click the **Upload** button to add any garment or pattern image. 3. Click ![Generate.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/45587052851097) button and an image will be generated for you to choose from. This process can be replicated until you get the desired outcome. Your image history can be found on the right side of the window.
content_description: Discover how to effortlessly create, edit, and grade patterns in CLO using the Pattern Drafter and innovative AI tools, enhancing your design workflow with customizable measurement options and intuitive features.

title: How to Solve "Error Code 400" Login Failure
content: This article explains how to solve login failures due to "Error Code: 400" and/or "Error Code: 10002". **Technical Background** Starting in March 2024, [the CLO team has integrated the different accounts of users](https://landing.clo-set.com/allatonce) using CLO software, CLO-SET, and CONNECT into one, and the CLO software have changed the login via CLO-SET webpage instead of entering ID and password in the login window. This policy will be applied from CLO version 2024.0, and previously released CLO 7.x or 6.x versions will run by entering ID and password. After the account integration, if the previously-used-user-login-information and the newly-integrated-user-information do not match, or if old-user-information is stored in the web browser being used, the CLO software login will fail and an error message will be displayed. **Problem Situations** ![001_ErrorCode_400.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/36701673887641) ![002_now_signed_in_to_CLO-SET.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/36701673892761) * Launched CLO, but get an error message instead of logging in. * Successfully logged in to CLO-SET on a web browser, but get an error message. * * * **Causes and Solutions** **In case of security app blocks CLO's internet connection** * If an antivirus, firewall, or web monitoring program installed on your computer blocks the CLO software from communicating with the Internet, CLO login will fail. * Change the Internet connection of CLO software to "Allow" in the detailed settings of your antivirus, firewall, or web monitoring program, and then run the CLO software again. **CLO software does not have sufficient file read and write permissions** * [**Refer to this web post**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/17074279996697) to grant administrator rights to the CLO software and then run CLO again. **CLO-SET password error** * [**Refer to this web post**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/29936192175129) to reset your CLO-SET password and then run CLO again. **Web browser security policy or web browser cache error** * Web browsers with strict security policies or specific web browsers may have problems accessing the CLO-SET webpage. In this case, please try using a different web browser instead of the one you were using. Also, check again your web browser's security settings. * You may be experiencing problems logging into CLO-SET due to an outdated web browser cache. In this case, clear your cache and try logging in again. This [**saved-search**](https://www.google.com/search?q=how+to+clear+web+browser+cache&oq=how+to+clear+web+browser+cache&gs_lcrp=EgZjaHJvbWUyBggAEEUYOdIBCDg1OTFqMGoxqAIAsAIA&sourceid=chrome&ie=UTF-8) will help. **CLO software configuration error** * The internal configuration and settings of the CLO software may have been damaged during the CLO Live Update and install. * [**Refer to this web post**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/16218721000601) to completely uninstall the CLO software and fresh install it using the latest installer. Don't forget to back up your working files to a safe place before uninstalling CLO software. * * * **Read More** * Learn more about [**CLO-SET Account Integration**](https://landing.clo-set.com/allatonce) here. See also [**CLO Account Integration User Guide**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/28934650069785). * If you have followed the steps above but are still unable to log in, please send us your screenshot or error code via [**Contact Us**](https://clo3d.com/en/support/contactus/technical).
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide to troubleshoot and resolve login failures related to "Error Code: 400" and "Error Code: 10002" following the integration of user accounts in the CLO software.

content: **List of Contents** Plot Patterns Recommended Plotter Specifications Plot 2D patterns to manufacture real garments. #### **Plot Patterns** 1. title: CLO Alumni Discount: Supporting Your Transition to the Professional World
content: Congratulations on your graduation! To support the next generation of designers, **CLO offers a special 50% discount for recent graduates.** This initiative aims to help you bridge the gap between your studies and your professional career by providing affordable access to our software. **What is the Alumni Discount?** Eligible graduates can receive **50% off** on both monthly and annual subscriptions. * **Duration:** Valid for one full year. * **Automatic Renewal:** After 12 months, your subscription will renew at the regular price unless canceled. ⚠️ Important: This discount is not compatible with active Student Subscriptions. You must wait for your student license to expire before applying. **Eligibility & Required Documentation** To qualify for this program, you must have been enrolled as a full-time student at an accredited university or school. Your graduation date must be within the **last six months.** You are required to provide one of the following official documents to verify your status: * **University Degree or Official Certificate:** This document must include your full name, the name of the institution, the date of completion, and the official signature/seal of the university. * **Official Graduation Letter:** A formal letter from your university confirming the successful completion of your program. **Note:** You must have a registered individual CLO account before applying. The coupon can be applied to new subscriptions or the next billing cycle of an existing one. **Application Steps** Follow these steps to request your discount: 1. **Prepare your files:** Ensure your proof of graduation is in a digital format (PDF or high-quality image). 2. **Submit a request:** Visit our **Contact Us** page and submit your request through the [**General Support** section](https://clo3d.com/en/support/contactus/general). 3. **Include Required Details** : In your message, you must: 1. Attach your official graduation documentation. 2. Provide the email address associated with your CLO account. 3. Specify if you prefer the Monthly or Annual plan 4. **Wait for verification:** Our team will review your documentation. Once approved, you will receive a response directly within your support ticket containing the specific steps to follow to get your discount. **Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)** **Can I apply if I graduated more than six months ago?** Unfortunately, no. This specific program is designed for very recent graduates. Your graduation or completion date must be within the six-month window prior to your application. **What happens if I cancel my subscription mid-year?** * **Monthly Plan:** The discount is tied to an active, continuous subscription. If you cancel it, you will immediately lose the 50% benefit and you will not be able to reactivate it for the remainder of that year. * **Annual Plan:** If you cancel the auto-renewal of your annual license, you will still enjoy the access you paid for until the end of the 12-month period, but the license will not renew for the following year. **Does the discount apply to both Monthly and Annual plans?** Yes. You can choose the plan that best fits your needs. The 50% reduction applies to the total price of the Annual plan or to each of the 12 monthly payments of the Monthly plan. **Can I use this discount if I already have an active subscription?** Yes, if you are already an Individual subscriber, the discount will be applied to your next billing cycle once verified. However, please note that this discount cannot be applied to active Student Subscriptions. If you are a student, you must wait for your current license to expire before applying for the Alumni Discount. **What happens after the one-year discount period ends?** Once the 12-month discount period is over, your subscription will automatically renew at the regular price unless you choose to cancel it before the renewal date.
content_description: Discover how recent graduates can take advantage of CLO's exclusive 50% alumni discount to enhance their design careers with affordable software access.

title: Register Pose/Motion
content: ## **New in 2024.2** #### **You can easily register the pose or motion from an FBX file as a file compatible with CLO avatars. ![Register Pose.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38075492713753) ** #### 1. Click the Main Menu » Avatar » **Register Pose/Motion** menu. 2. Select the type to register, either **Pose** or **Motion**. 3. Open the FBX file by clicking on the ![open.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/38075383168153) **Open** button. 4. Select the Gender of the compatible CLO avatar and select the Shoe Type for female. **📝****Note:** If the FBX file's joint names do not match the CLO avatar's, it can only be saved and cannot be registered as the CLO-compatible file. 5. For motion, switch to Animation mode to play loaded motion as needed. 6. Click the **Save** button to save as the Pose(POS) or Motion(MTN) file.
content_description: Discover how to seamlessly register poses and motions from FBX files for CLO avatars in the new 2024.2 update.

title: POM Object Browser
content: ## **New in 2024.2** **List of Content** Folders Add Move Delete View Graded Sizes #### **Improving the POM object browser so users can organize and view they points of measure easily within CLO.** **** #### #### **Organize Folders** Using the folders within POM will allow you to organize all your POM however you like, for example you could organize them by pattern piece, or by measurement type, any way that works for you. ![Youtube Icon.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55674683001881) [Watch Video](https://youtu.be/v5VF7j7rrBc) ![Divider_Dash.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/37883938236185) #### **Add** 1. Edit the folder name and then click away or hit Enter key to apply the changes. * Afterwards, double-click on the folder name to rename it. 3. Click on the ![add.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/37543357840665) **Add** button within folder to add new POM within a folder. 4. title: Flatten
content: **Extract Patterns based on lines and shapes created on an Avatar.** **** **📝****Note:** * The Flattening function only extracts closed shapes as Patterns. * Since version 2024.2, the 2D pattern position and rotation are more aligned with the pattern placement on the 3D avatar. It is recommended to use CLO avatar for extracting the ideal pattern with front and back positions in the 2D window. When using a non-CLO avatar (eg. FBX) or missing the avatar, it is possible to lead to a non-ideal pattern position in the 2D window. #### 1. In the 3D toolbar, press and hold the **![3D Pen Avatar On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/55637066431513)3D Pen (Avatar)** and switch to the ![Flatten On.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/49948392732569) **Flatten.** **** 2. Hover the mouse over the shape to be extracted as Pattern. 3. Select all areas to be extracted by holding Shift on the keyboard, then clicking on the desired areas. 4. Press**Enter** on the keyboard. → The selected areas on the Avatar are converted to patterns and appear in both the 3D and 2D windows. → Sewing lines are automatically established for adjacent Patterns. 5. Hold down **Shift** and press **Enter.** → The intersecting area is flattened into a single pattern.
content_description: This web page provides guidance on extracting patterns from an Avatar using the Flattening function, ensuring optimal placement and alignment for both 2D and 3D applications.

title: Avatar (AVT) Open/Add/Save
content: **List of Contents** **Open/Add Avatar** **Save Avatar** **** Model (*.dae or *.obj), sizing data (*.avs), pose (*.pos), motion (*.mtn), accessory (*.acc), bounding volume (*.pan), all avatar-related files such as arrangement points (*.arr) can be saved and loaded into one file (*.avt). **** #### **Open/Add Avatar** 1. Click the File ▶ Open/Add ▶ **Avatar** in the top menus. 2. Select an avatar file. → Open/Add Avatar pop-up window appears. 3. Set the details and click **OK**. **Load Type** | Open | Load your avatar. ---|---|--- Add | Add your avatar. Load as Morph Target | Load the avatar as a morph target. **Translation** | X | Move horizontally based on the center of the 3D garment window. Y | Move vertically based on the center of the 3D garment window. Z | Move forward and backward based on the center of the 3D garment window. Unit | Select the unit of travel distance. **📝 Note:** When adding an avatar, arrangement point is maintained individually for each avatar. **** #### **Save Avatar** 1. Click the File ▶ Save As ▶ **Avatar** in the top menus. → An open file window appears. 2. Specify the location to save the garment file and enter a name and click **Save** to save it. **📝 Note:** * If multiple avatars are loaded, select one avatar and save it as an *.avt file. * When changing the file type to **Encrypted Avatar File(*.avte)** in the Avatar Save window, save it as an encrypted file that cannot be restored to other 3D files and avatar files (AVT).
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide for users on how to open, add, and save avatar files within a 3D garment design application, including detailed steps and important notes for managing avatar-related data.

title: Does CLO offer student discounts?
content: **Question** Does CLO offer student discounts? **Answer** Yes, we offer a 50% discount on an Individual plan to eligible high school, college, and university students worldwide. Discounted price will be $25 USD/month or $225 USD/year. **Important Note:** To receive the student discount, you must verify your student status before starting your trial. If you fail to do so, you will not be eligible for the discount. **Student Eligibility** To qualify for a student discount, you must be at least 13 years old and enrolled in one of the following: * University or college - full-time students in an accredited university or college that offers degrees. * Primary or secondary school - full-time students in an accredited primary or secondary school. **Important Note:** The CLO Student Discount is limited to 4 years. If still enrolled after 4 years proof of continued enrollment is required for an additional 2 year extension of the Student Discount once. **I'm eligible. How can I get the student discount?** Please check if your student email is already approved with CLO: [**Student Eligibility Check**](https://clo3d.com/en/student-eligibility) * **When your school domain is already approved** , 1. 1. Add your student email. 2. The **USE EMAIL ADDRESS** button will be activated. Click on the button and create your account. 3. Your account will be automatically applied to the student discount. (You can see the discounted price on your checkout page after the subscription button.) * **If your school domain is not approved or you don't have a student email address,** 1. 1. Go to the [**SIGN UP**](https://style.clo-set.com/en/account/signup?returnUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fclo3d.com%2Fauth%2Fsignin%3FredirectTo%3D%2F) page and select Individual. 2. Create your CLO account using either your student email address (if available) or your personal email address. 3. Our support team will review your documents and apply for the discount if approved. * **If you already have an account with us,** Simply [Contact Us](https://clo3d.com/en/support/contactus) and submit your proof of enrollment. *Please note that if you can't use your school email after graduation, you would face an issue with receiving CLO emails such as renewal notifications and any CLO news. *

title: Edit Simulation Properties
content: ### **Objective** Configure the simulation properties for advanced scene settings. **Location ** Object Browser ▶ ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/36782471113753) Scene ▶ Environment ▶ **Simulation Properties** ** Operation** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. → The simulation properties appear in the Property Editor. 2. Refer to the below table and edit the simulation properties as needed. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Preset** | Instead of selecting the [simulation mode](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000304968-Simulation) from the 3D toolbar, you can choose predefined presets here. Normal, Fitting, and GPU simulations are primarily used. **Time Step** | This determines the time values calculated within the simulation engine. The smaller you set it, the more sophisticated it will be, but it will also require more calculations and will, resultingly, be slower. The default values are recommended. **Number of Simulation** | When calculating cloth simulation for a given time step, this denotes how many substeps one simulation calculation is divided into. For example, if you are calculating a time step of 0.03 and number of simulation is 10, the actual time step will be 0.003. Simulating multiple times with these smaller time intervals ensures both more numerically accurate results and stable collision handling, but takes much longer. **CG Finish Condition, CG Iteration Count, CG Residual** | Clothing simulation is the process of solving a large linear system. Large linear systems can be solved using a numerical analysis method called conjugate gradient method (CG). CG improves the accuracy of the answer through iterative calculations. The condition for CG ending can be set by the number of iterations or when the error (=residual) falls below a certain value. Iteration: Because it repeats only a certain number of times and ends unconditionally, it is faster but may be less accurate. Residual: It is slower but can be more accurate because it stops when the error falls below a certain value. **Self Collision Iteration Count** | Defines the number of collision calculations for the clothing. More collision calculations produce more precise results, but they are also slower. Please use the default value. **Air Damping** | The resistance that the garment receives from the air. **Gravity** | Defines the most important gravity values in your simulation. If this value is adjusted, simulation results will become unrealistic. Please use the default value, unless you want to, for example, create a weightless simulation. **Number of CPU in Use** | This determines the number of physical cores within the CPU that will be used for the simulation. CLO can technically use up to 12 cores, which are automatically defined based on your computer. Even if it is a high-end CPU with 16 cores, up to 12 can be used. This may vary depending on the CPU manufacturer and actual CPU products. This value is best also left at default. **Nonlinear Simulation** | Linear or non-linear is an important factor in all fields of computer graphics, simulation, rendering and engineering. By analogy, the real world is non-linear, but computer implementations are linear. Nonlinearity is a technique that makes things look very real, and simulating them this way is sophisticated, but slow. If Fitting simulation is run, this option is selected. t's slower because it's more complicated and requires a lot of calculations. **Ground, Avatar-Cloth Collision Detection, Self-Collision Detection, Proximity Detection** | All of these are intended to simulate collisions and friction between the clothing and the avatar. Because CLO calculates numerous contacts and collisions between the fabric and the body, the simulation looks natural and realistic. It is recommended that these values are also left at their default. **※Note:** **Use the Open & Save buttons on the top of the Property Editor to save, open, and reuse the settings.**
content_description: This web page provides guidance on configuring simulation properties for advanced scene settings in CLO, enabling users to optimize cloth simulation accuracy and performance.

title: I get an error message saying, "Due to a network issue, you are unable to login at this time" or "Delayed network connection." What can I do?
content: **Question** I get an error message saying, "Due to a network issue, you are unable to login at this time" or "Delayed network connection." What can I do? **Answer** There are six possible cases for this issue. Please see them below and adopt appropriate solution. * **Due to internet disconnection** * Please connect to the internet and try logging in again. * **Due to slow internet speed when connecting to CLO authentication server.** * Please change your authentication type by [contacting us](https://www.clo3d.com/contact). * **Due to an anti-virus program** * An anti-virus of a PC may inhibit launching CLO. Please uninstall the anti-virus program and try logging in again. If CLO launches successfully after the uninstall, please [contact us](https://www.clo3d.com/contact). * **Due to a user PC's firewall setting** * The firewall setting of a PC may inhibit launching CLO. Please unblock the firewall and try logging in again. If CLO launches successfully after the uninstall, please[ contact us](https://www.clo3d.com/contact). * **Due to a user's company's firewall setting** * Sometimes, a company may have a firewall setting interfere with CLO. Please check with in-house IT team. * **Due to a user's proxy server setting** * Please [contact us](https://www.clo3d.com/contact) for the help.
content_description: This webpage provides solutions to resolve login issues caused by network errors, including guidance for internet disconnections, firewall settings, and proxy server configurations.
